source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(cols) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)}) == 1]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [rows]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [cols]
    row_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_edges, row_edges[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_spans = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_edges, col_edges[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    nonsep = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans
              for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    background = Counter(nonsep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            panel = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            count = sum(value != background for value in panel)
            out_row.append(1 if count > 1 else background)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
'''
